profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at State Farm ®
profile.summary:
I am a Lead Software Engineer at State Farm Insurance in the DFW area. I graduated B.S. in Computer Science from the University of Texas at Dallas with Magna Cum Laude Latin Honor and 3.82 GPA. I also graduated with a Master of Science in Cybersecurity at Georgia Institute of Technology. I am interested in connecting with IT professionals.

My current projects involve working on full-stack application with UI front end and REST API backend to provide  Homeowners and Renters quote and purchase capability using Spring Framework and Angular. I work with a DevOps mentality with Agile methodology. I am using automation tools with Jenkins, GitLab runner pipeline. I use Maven for build tool.

I love working in software development, preferably in object-oriented programming with Java, C#, SQL, and Agile Development. I have been working in a professional work environment at State Farm for 4+ years as part of a team. I am able to utilize time management, communication, critical thinking, and problem solving skills to contribute to the company’s success. 

My portfolio: www.killianwin.wordpress.com

My GitHub repository, including academic and personal projects : https://github.com/khanguyen07

• Strong foundation knowledge in data structures and algorithmic analysis: Array List, Linked List, Doubly Linked List, Binary Tree, AVL Tree, Red Black Tree, Sets, Maps, Separate Chaining, Hash Functions, Hopscotch Hashing, Merge Sort, Quicksort, Dijkstra, Kruskal, recursion, runtime analysis with Big O Notation. 
• Knowledge of Object Oriented Programming languages including Java & Spring Framework, C#.
• Knowledge of MS SQL Server and Apache Derby database query languages.
• Web-development with Angular 8.0, Node.js, HTML, CSS, PHP, XML, Javascript.
• Familiar with Agile development.

• Bilingual in English and Vietnamese: Speaking, Reading and Writing.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed full-stack application with UI front-end and API back-end to provide Homeowners and Renters quote and purchase capability using Spring and Angular.
- Worked with a DevOps mentality with Agile methodology. Using CI/CD automation tools with Jenkins, GitLab pipeline. Using Maven for build tool.
- Successfully deployed application to production in 50 states result in a 7% increase in voluntary policy gain in Q1-Q3 2021.
- Utilized a working knowledge of industry leading development skills tools, processes,
applications, environments, data practices and programming language(s) to complete
stories and features.
- Monitored and resolving routine production issues using Splunk.
- Led tactical work, contributes to strategic work. 
- Created new or modifying existing
applications/tools to meet technical specifications or business needs and coordinates
team activities as needed.

positions.title: Underwriting Service Assistant
positions.description:
- Researched policy information and enter policy changes with 100% quality.
- Responded to agents and policyholders’ questions regarding policy billing and processing. 
- Processed high volume policy changes across the U.S. using guidelines and procedures that comply with state laws.
- Volunteered as a member of career committee to help employees advance their employment within the company. Helped organize group mentoring lunch events via online Skype meetings.

positions.title: Data Technician
positions.description:
- Consistently achieved 100% quality and quantity work performance. 
- Securely handled company and customers’ information. 
- Prepared checks for deposit by encoding customer payment amounts using Image Transport equipment.
- Transmitted information entered to customer's accounts receivable systems.
